Use this when secure credential storage or an earlier session recovery is unavailable. This removes the saved login credential and hides the current account. Scores, catalog and settings are kept. The Phi-Plugin API token is restored when a readable copy remains; otherwise you will need to enter it again.

Local session reset is incomplete. Your scores and catalog were kept, but an old credential may still remain. Retry the reset; if secure storage remains unavailable, restart the app and retry. If your API token could not be restored, enter it again in Settings.
The previous local session reset has not finished. Your scores and catalog are safe. Retry the reset below before logging in.

Secure credential storage is unavailable in this process, so retrying login cannot save your credentials. Use “Repair or reset local session” below, or restart the app and try again. Scores are kept; the API token is restored only when a readable copy remains.

An earlier session recovery could not be verified. Retry login to probe it again; if it remains blocked, use “Repair or reset local session” below. This protects a previous account's data from being cleared by mistake.
The previous account's local data could not be cleared, so a new login is blocked. Retry, or use local session reset to hide that account without deleting its scores.

The previous account is hidden, but its old credential could not be fully removed. Retry, or use local session reset to rebuild credential storage. Scores are kept; the API token is restored only when a readable copy remains.
Your new credential was saved, but the previous recovery marker could not be cleared. Retry login to finish recovery; do not reset storage unless the problem persists.
